[[File:Tiercam_Dam_TEGTPM.jpg|thumb|250px|The Imperial dam]]
'''Tiercam Dam''' was a [[Dam/Legends|dam]] that was built on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], named after its Imperial designer. 780 meters tall and 2km wide, it was visible for miles. Before vacating the planet, the Imperials stripped the dam of its exterior plating. Since this time, it has on occasion served as a haven for criminals. It burst in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] and flooded the [[Valley of Royalty]] with toxic waste. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Ken]] were able to save several [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] archeologists, but [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]] lost his [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] to the [[Acid/Legends|acid]] flood.
